name: Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)
benefit: - **Variable Grant Amount:** The grant percentage is tailored to the needs of different market committees, offering 25% for 'A' and 'B' class committees and 50% for 'C' and 'D' class committees.- **Maximum Assistance:** The maximum financial assistance provided under the scheme is capped at ₹1,50,00,000/-, ensuring substantial support for eligible projects.
_eligibility_text: - Co-operative institutions are eligible under this scheme. - The institutions must set up a processing unit in the general area of an APMC.
